stem.text: A man sits on a buggy that is pulled along by a wire attached to a kite. The wire is at an angle of $40^{\circ}$ to the horizontal and has a constant tension of $200\,\text{N}$. The man and buggy travel a distance of $20\,\text{m}$ along a straight horizontal path. The wire and the path of the buggy are in the same vertical plane.

stem.alt: Kite, wire and a man on a buggy on a horizontal line; labels: kite, wire, 200 N, 40°, buggy.

stem.text: What is the work done by the tension force on the man and buggy?
